hooks.text: 聚落必须赶在Ginnungagap吞噬前推进，失败后带着知识重启循环
hooks.excerpt: Players’ settlements will constantly be in a race against time to avoid the Ginnungagap. Each failure will bring them back to the beginning of their adventure, where they can start anew with more knowledge and a better mastery of the game mechanics.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 永久可定制枢纽Holt解锁新机制与跨局升级，帮助部族重建
hooks.excerpt: The Holt is your permanent, customizable home and acts as the main hub of the game. Unlock new mechanics and permanent upgrades that will help you rebuild your tribe!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每轮开始增删建筑卡，牌组直接决定该循环可用建筑与发展机会
hooks.excerpt: Before each run, add and remove building cards to your deck to create different challenges and opportunities each time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 控制器支持故障到无法使用。

excerpts.excerpt: controller support is bugged to the point of being unusable.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 增加难度更像增加繁琐而非挑战。

excerpts.excerpt: Adding difficulty feels more tedious than it is challenging.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 元进程奖励过小，缺乏存在感。

excerpts.excerpt: the rewards are so small and trivial they feel like they don't matter at all.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 每轮城市建造容易让玩家继续再开一局。

excerpts.excerpt: overwhelming desire to build one more town before bed.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 资源扩张与限时竞速结合得深而放松。

excerpts.excerpt: deep but chill resource/expansion race-against-time game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: Overall, great puzzle game, great mechanics
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多个类型系统能直观地协同运作。

excerpts.excerpt: It's very intuitive and all works reasonably well together.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
